title: Lineage sidecar (PROV-lite JSON)
description: Mainline F1: lineage sidecar format (PROV-lite JSON) carried by corpus/skill/profile files. W3C PROV core classes (arch §5.1): Entity (the file/block), Activity (the transformation), Agent (the author). Field set mirrors the L3 lineage set (§3.2.1: every entry carries author, source type, evidence, transformation, confidence, update history) so a sidecar and its L3 record agree by construction.

entity_id.description: PROV Entity: the corpus entry / skill / profile object (or entry_id#block_id for block-level lineage, §3.3.2)

generated_by.description: PROV Activity: the transformation that produced the entity

agent.description: PROV Agent: authoring agent/human (load-bearing lineage field)

sources.description: The entities this one was derived from (lineage-DAG edges; L9 deletion walks these)

source_type.description: Load-bearing lineage field: kind of source (principal-direct, harness-artifact, connector:<name>, agent-derivation, external-untrusted)

locator.description: Where the source is/was (path, id, URL)

content_hash.description: Hash of the source content as used (evidence integrity)

basis.description: How this derivation edge is known (Graphify-borrow, sharper than the free-text confidence label): 'extracted' = read directly/verbatim from the source; 'inferred' = resolved/derived by the agent; 'ambiguous' = uncertain, routes to human review (gate 'ask'). Optional; a missing basis is read as 'ambiguous' by consumers — you always know what was found vs guessed.

evidence.description: Load-bearing lineage field: block-level citations supporting the content (entry_id#block_id refs or external locators)

confidence.description: Load-bearing lineage field: graded label or 'unrated'

basis.description: Entity-level basis = the WEAKEST edge basis among `sources` (any ambiguous edge → ambiguous; else any inferred → inferred; else extracted). Derived by the writer; a missing source basis counts as ambiguous.

update_history.description: Load-bearing lineage field: prior generations of this entity
